newsitem.title: USA: San Miguel plans Tex. plant maintenance. [CORRECTED 19:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: San Miguel plans Tex. plant maintenance. [CORRECTED 19:15 GMT]

text.p: San Miguel Electric Cooperative Inc (corrects from South Texas Electric Cooperative Inc) plans to shut its 400 megawatt San Miguel coal-fired power plant next week for maintenance, a company spokeswoman said Friday.
The unit will be shut Oct 21 and will be down for no more than five days, the spokeswoman said, adding the outage is part of a regular fall maintenance program at the plant.
San Miguel is located about 40 miles south of San Antonio, Texas.
